grid.expression: SELECT DADOS.*, CASE WHEN MOD(ROWNUM,2) = 0 THEN '#DCDCDC' ELSE '#FFDAB9' END AS BKCOLOR FROM (SELECT C.NUNOTA, C.NUMNOTA, C.VLRNOTA, C.CODPARC, CASE WHEN P.NOMEPARC = '<SEM PARCEIRO>' THEN 'PEDIDO' ELSE P.NOMEPARC END AS PARCEIRO, C.DTENTSAI, C.DTALTER, trunc(sysdate) - C.DTENTSAI DIASSEMCONFIRMAR, CASE WHEN C.TIPMOV = 'O' THEN 'PEDIDO COMPRA' WHEN C.TIPMOV = 'P' THEN 'PEDIDO VENDA' WHEN C.TIPMOV = 'J' THEN 'PEDIDO' WHEN C.TIPMOV = 'Q' THEN 'BAIXA' WHEN C.TIPMOV = 'V' THEN 'VENDA' WHEN C.TIPMOV = 'C' THEN 'COMPRA' WHEN C.TIPMOV = 'T' THEN 'TRANSF.' WHEN C.TIPMOV = 'F' THEN 'PRODUÇÃO' ELSE 'OUTROS' END AS TIPMOV, U.NOMEUSU, TPO.DESCROPER FROM TGFCAB C INNER JOIN TGFPAR P ON (C.CODPARC = P.CODPARC) INNER JOIN TSIUSU U ON (C.CODUSUINC = U.CODUSU) INNER JOIN TGFTOP TPO ON (C.CODTIPOPER = TPO.CODTIPOPER AND C.DHTIPOPER = TPO.DHALTER) WHERE C.STATUSNOTA <> 'L' AND C.TIPMOV <> 'Z' AND C.TIPMOV <> 'O' AND C.TIPMOV <> 'P' AND C.TIPMOV <> 'J' AND C.TIPMOV <> 'Q' AND C.TIPMOV <> 'F' ORDER BY 10,11 ASC, C.DTNEG ASC) DADOS
